comment: A made-up creature script that uses every kind of named operand, with its own small name registry, to check that the GDScript (FoeAsm, FoeNames) and the Python (foe_text.py, foe_names.py) disassemblers write the same text and that the assembler reads it back to the same bytes. Hand-made: it has nothing of the original game. Used by godot/tests/engine/test_foe_names_operands.gd and tools/import/test_foe_names.py.
text:
start:
    Play_Sound probe_sound
    Play_Sound 6
    Play_Sound 99
    Set_Frame probe_zone_pic
    Set_Frame probe_zone_pic mirrored
    Set_Frame 41 mirrored
    Set_Frame probe_common mirrored
    Set_Frame_Range probe_common probe_zone_pic
    Move_Foe_Relative_XY -2 3 1 mirrored
    Move_Foe_To_XY 10 20 probe_zone_pic mirrored
    Move_Foe_To_Screen_XY 10 20 41 probe_cave
    Put_Foe_To_Sleep probe_boss
    Put_Foe_To_Sleep self+1
    Wake_Foe 9
    Set_Flag probe_gate
    Clear_Flag 3
    If_Flag probe_finale
    Hide_Foe
    Jump_To start
